import numpy as np, json
def solve(inp):
    I=np.array(inp); H,W=I.shape; out=np.zeros_like(I)
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0]
    assert len(seeds)==1, seeds
    sr,sc=seeds[0]; v=I[sr][sc]
    dirs=[(1,-1),(1,1)]  # down-left, down-right
    for dr,dc in dirs:
        r,c=sr+dr,sc+dc; col=v; bounced=False
        while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
            out[r][c]=col
            if bounced: break
            if c==0 or c==W-1:  # hit vertical wall -> bounce, recolor
                dc*=-1; bounced=True; col=1 if v==2 else 2
                # move again with new direction
                r+=dr; c+=dc
            else:
                r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out.tolist()

# Simulate a single billiard ray and check whether the set of 1-cells = cells passed, minus ray cells
def traj(H,W,seedc,d=(1,1)):
    r,c=0,seedc
    dr,dc=d
    seen=[]
    for _ in range(4*H*W):
        r+=dr; c+=dc
        if r>=H: dr=-1; r-=2*dr
        if c>=W: dc=-1; c-=2*dc
        if r==H-1: break
        seen.append((r,c))
    return seen
for n,sc in ((2,2),(3,3),(1,6)):
    H_=arr(f'Demo pair {n} output').shape[0]; W_=arr(f'Demo pair {n} output').shape[1]
    S=set(traj(H_,W_,sc))
    O=arr(f'Demo pair {n} output')
    ones={(r,c) for r in range(H_) for c in range(W_) if O[r][c]==1}
    print(n,'S==ones?',S==ones,'missed',sorted(ones-S)[:8],'extra',sorted(S-ones)[:8])
